title: WaterColor "Over Under" 45 Watercolor Blvd W #104
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 6 amenity access bands.**- Smart TVs In All Rooms- 3 Outdoor Balconies- On-Site Parking- Ground floor entry- Fully Equipped Kitchen- Coffee Maker & Keurig - Clothes Washer & Dryer- Hair Dryers in each bath- 2 Bicycles included, with more to rent just steps away- Access to Watercolor Beach Club and 5 community pools- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Conveniently located next to Cerulean Park, this newly remodeled condominium is just a two minute walk to restaurants, a five minute walk to Watercolor Beach Club, the Beach, and the Boathouse Pool on Western Lake, where you can rent canoes, paddle boards, etc. An easy 10 minute walk to Seaside means no need to drive to dinner or look for parking.With windows on three sides, sunlight fills every room. The second-floor living area includes an open family room, kitchen, and dining area with table seating for six and three more at the bar. A bonus room with twin bunk beds and an over-sized half bath are nearby. The family room has all new furnishings, including two sofas and a 75'' smart tv. Step out of the family room onto the balcony with lovely views of the park. There is also a charming balcony for two to escape with a cup of morning coffee or evening glass of wine.The first floor Primary Bedroom offers a king bed, private bathroom with double vanity and walk in shower. Enjoy a lazy evening in the adjacent screened porch with a sofa and swing for two. Down the hall from the master is a cozy bonus twin over twin bunk room. The Guest Bedroom has a queen bed with Smart TV, as well as a private bathroom with tub and shower.Bike to community pools or explore nearby Grayton Beach State Park on two included adult bikes. After a day at the beach, Cerulean Park is a great place to toss a ball around in the sun, or simply sit and relax by the gardens and water features. From here you can venture out onto one of the many scenic, nature trails that wind throughout the neighborhood with stunning views of Western Lake.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR: -Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Walk-In Shower-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo-Bunk Room: 1st Floor: Twin over Twin-Bonus Bunk: Twin over Twin Bunk 2nd Floor & Half Bath*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
